Subject: Constitution of Task Force for expediting disposal of pending legal cases
regarding. 
Sir. 
On perusal of pendency list of court cases on LIMBS Portal it has been observed that 
large number of legal cases are pending before various legal fora/courts. Therefore, in order 
to expedite the disposal of these pending cases, following Task Force is constituted at the 
level of Head Office (for cases pending before Supreme Court, NCLATs and NCDRC) and 
each Zonal Office (for cases pending before remaining legal fora/courts). 
ACC (HQ) Legal 
RPFC-I, Legal 
RPFC-II, Legal

The concerned Task Force is directed to ensure the necessary action for expediting the

(This issues with the approval of competent authority)
Yours faithfully. 
(Navendu Rai)
